title: What Do Vacuum Valves and Gate Valves Protect? How They Work in Semiconductor Equipment and How to Troubleshoot Faults
excerpt: We explain how vacuum valves and gate valves in semiconductor equipment isolate and connect chambers, load locks, and pumps. Linking differential pressure and conductance, pneumatic drive, position sensors, and interlocks, we break down the causes of a valve alarm from an equipment maintenance perspective.
